string.name: guide_connect_step1
string.value: Put this device and the console on the same Wi-Fi, or join the console to this device's dedicated hotspot.

string.name: guide_connect_step2
string.value: Tap Start streaming on the console card; if it does not appear, enter the address manually.

string.name: guide_connect_step3
string.value: Start a game on the console and the picture appears.

string.name: guide_connect_title
string.value: Connect and stream

string.name: guide_disclaimer
string.value: NSSFT only receives and plays the stream; it does not provide or modify any software on the console.

string.name: guide_faq_a1
string.value: Check that SFT is set to Network and the console has been restarted, and that both are on the same network. Some routers block broadcasts between devices; use Enter address manually in that case.

string.name: guide_faq_a2
string.value: SFT is still set to USB. Change it to Network in the manager app, then restart the console.

string.name: guide_faq_a3
string.value: By default SFT streams games only; there is no picture on the home menu. Start a game.

string.name: guide_faq_a4
string.value: When the network drops a frame, the picture holds the last good frame and the console is asked for a keyframe right away, so it usually recovers in a moment. You can turn off Freeze on frame loss in Settings.

string.name: guide_faq_a5
string.value: SFT accepts one receiver at a time. Disconnect the receiver on the computer or other device first.

string.name: guide_faq_q1
string.value: The home screen never finds the console?

string.name: guide_faq_q2
string.value: It says the console answered but is not streaming over the network?

string.name: guide_faq_q3
string.value: Connected, but still waiting for the game picture?

string.name: guide_faq_q4
string.value: The picture pauses briefly now and then?

string.name: guide_faq_q5
string.value: A computer can connect but this app cannot?

string.name: guide_faq_title
string.value: FAQ

string.name: guide_open_sft
string.value: Open the SFT project page

string.name: guide_prepare_step1
string.value: Install SFT on the console; see the SFT project page.

string.name: guide_prepare_step2
string.value: In the SFT manager app, set Connection to Network and restart the console.

string.name: guide_prepare_step3
string.value: SFT starts about 30 seconds after booting.

string.name: guide_prepare_title
string.value: Prepare the console

string.name: guide_quality_body
string.value: Docked over the network is native 1080p, handheld usually 720p; when the network is tight the console lowers quality to keep the frame rate. Tap the menu button at the top center and adjust Freeze on frame loss and Picture enhancement under Stream options.

string.name: guide_quality_tip
string.value: A nearby dedicated hotspot or the dock's LAN port is steadiest.

string.name: guide_quality_title
string.value: Quality and smoothness

string.name: guide_sft_1080_body
string.value: Docked over the network is 1080p; handheld is 720p unless an extra module outputs the docked picture. Sizes such as 1600×900 go out at 720p unless Scale other docked sizes up to 1080p is on (Picture page).

string.name: guide_sft_1080_title
string.value: When you get 1080p

string.name: guide_sft_60_body
string.value: At stock clocks 1080p runs a little under 60 fps; a CPU at 1785 MHz reaches 60. For heavy scenes, turn on Faster memory while streaming (Picture page).

string.name: guide_sft_60_title
string.value: When you get a full 60 fps

string.name: guide_sft_cheat_body
string.value: With a game modifier loaded, reading the picture is several times slower, so turn it off while streaming. Programs with anti-debug protection cannot be streamed.

string.name: guide_sft_cheat_title
string.value: Game modifiers slow the picture

string.name: guide_sft_intro
string.value: Set in the SFT manager app on the console; tap to read

string.name: guide_sft_mem_body
string.value: Modules share a few MB of system memory; without enough, SFT does not start. Check usage in the Setup page and turn off modules you do not need.

string.name: guide_sft_mem_title
string.value: Too many modules stop SFT from starting

string.name: guide_sft_one_body
string.value: SFT and other streaming modules (such as SysDVR) compete for the recording service and can conflict or fail to start. Keep only SFT on.

string.name: guide_sft_one_title
string.value: Run only one streaming module

string.name: guide_sft_sound_body
string.value: Games that block recording have no sound by default; turn on Sound in no-record games in SFT and restart.

string.name: guide_sft_sound_title
string.value: No sound in games that block recording

string.name: guide_sft_title
string.value: SFT setup notes

string.name: guide_sft_usb_body
string.value: In handheld mode, set SFT to USB - PC viewer, restart, and connect the console with a data cable; the home screen then shows "Console found over USB". With a C-to-C cable a phone or tablet may end up as the USB device; an OTG adapter is more reliable. Each boot uses either USB or the network.

string.value: Connecting over USB
